description: This header file defines interfaces, macros, and constants for general input/output pin management in embedded firmware, including pin mode assertions, GPIO handling, and ICU (Input Capture Unit) configurations.

methods.name: efiSetPadMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of a specified pin, used for configuring pin functionality.

methods.name: efiReadPin
methods.description: Reads the logical state of a specified input pin.

methods.name: getInputMode
methods.description: Retrieves the input mode configuration for a pin.

methods.name: efiIcuStart
methods.description: Initializes the Input Capture Unit (ICU) with provided configuration.
